title: FYI Yachts Adds Iconic 126’ Oceanco Raised Pilothouse to Lease-Purchase Program
description: FYI Yachts expands its lease-to-own portfolio with a 1994 126’ Oceanco Raised Pilothouse, offering buyers a flexible path to ownership of a legendary, ocean-ready vessel.
html:
Miami, FL – FYI Yachts proudly expands its exclusive lease-to-purchase program with the addition of a legendary 1994 126’ Oceanco Raised Pilothouse, further cementing its leadership in delivering innovative yacht acquisition solutions.

A Landmark Addition to FYI’s Lease-to-Own Fleet

This distinguished 126-foot Oceanco represents a significant step in FYI’s mission to offer clients flexible ownership paths to world-class vessels. Known for its timeless design and proven global cruising capabilities, the yacht brings enduring pedigree, reliability, and luxury to the firm’s growing lease-purchase portfolio.

Flexible Ownership, Global Capability

Through FYI’s tailored lease-purchase structure, clients can enjoy immediate operational access to this Oceanco while building equity over time. This strategic approach is ideal for buyers seeking a gradual, financially efficient transition into long-range yachting—without compromising on vessel quality or performance.

Why Choose FYI Yachts?

FYI Yachts continues to redefine yacht acquisition by matching discerning buyers with exceptional vessels and personalized ownership solutions. The 126’ Oceanco stands as a prime example of FYI’s ability to connect passionate owners with yachts that blend heritage, seaworthiness, and refined luxury.
